baseline.note: Current public product claims are a requirement inventory, not proof of implementation. The repository has retired the page's older herdr backend reference; the supported terminal backend is tmux.

requirements.remaining: Read-only full reviewed-word recovery is implemented and tested across USB session replacement, with a metadata-only Pro restart bookmark. Network transcription, microphone quality and physical latency still need a device trial. Language expansion is excluded.

requirements.remaining: The native checks reject known blockers before speech and retain exact local/recipient guards through queued actions. requirements.requirement: Browse agents and machines, with explicit desktop visits and a truthful Return path
requirements.remaining: Exercise local and remote machines with the physical device. Reviewed Goal/Loop currently rejects remote recipients rather than routing through an unverified path.
requirements.latest_implementation: Current-pane Summary offers Latest output directly; other-pane/legacy Summary keeps Open on desktop. Frozen contact/worker identity refuses stale actions. The actual app preserves original Return across repeated peeks and another alert, restoring the same pane/session/terminal/renderer/controllers and 240.25 reading offset with zero input. requirements.requirement: Read and answer agent questions deliberately, without losing or duplicating uncertain answers
requirements.remaining: Unanswered questions now survive read acknowledgments, unread refreshes and USB-session replacement. Host catalog/review receipts are bounded to 64 agent IDs and the daemon lifetime. Pro keeps 72 attention cards, protects current reading and retained answers, admits new questions on overflow and points older attention to Harness. While an answer is pending, only Review answer opens it; new Answer shortcuts wait for exact resolution or local Close. Actual native app transport and firmware replay use synthetic questions, not vendor inference or physical USB. Real app-question, physical interruption and runtime-heap trials remain.
requirements.latest_implementation: Multi-question packets now support local Previous and correction without refetching or losing later choices/spoken answers. Back and right-swipe agree, and only final Send answers transmits the packet. Stale/pending/uncertain guards are replay-tested.

requirements.requirement: Carry a passage to another agent, with pinned source and recipient and readable review
requirements.remaining: Physical cable/touch, microphone, transcription reliability, latency and vendor execution remain unverified. The app journey substitutes a fixed transcript and owned dispatch callback. Picker reach is the active tab's known16 pane rows, not fleet search. Full Carry attachment is not restored by draft-page recovery after power loss.
requirements.latest_implementation: Quiet current-tab recipient picker; cancellation and same-recipient choice preserve the tray and valid Return. Exact tray/host/target/focus pins guard contact and queued work. Actual app complete Carry with reviewed replacement words, one dispatch and exact Return passes.

requirements.latest_implementation: Existing map/list geometry gains a temporary Choose a pane purpose and one frozen-source line. Ten native layouts independently reviewed. Actual app Carry/Return preserves exact fractional offset and six object identities; no additional Home control.
